First, note that 51 weeks + 7 days = 51 weeks + 1 week = 52 weeks.  
52 weeks = 364 days.  

Start date: 1204-09-13.  
Add 364 days:  
1204 is a leap year (divisible by 4 and also by 400? No, but in the Julian calendar, leap year every 4 years; Gregorian not adopted yet, but we follow Gregorian arithmetic as per rules).  
In Gregorian, 1204 is a leap year (divisible by 4, not by 100 unless divisible by 400; 1204 divisible by 4, not by 100 → leap).  
From 1204-09-13 to 1205-09-12 is 365 days (since leap year Feb has 29 days, but starting after Feb, so 365 days for full year).  
We need 364 days, so 1 day less than a full year: 1205-09-11.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1205-09-11
